scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend-farmer && npm install --prefix frontend-mao && npm install --prefix frontend-admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend-farmer && npm run build --prefix frontend-mao && npm run build --prefix frontend-admin
scripts.presentation:setup: npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev:all: start "AgriPrice Backend" cmd /k "npm run dev:backend" && start "AgriPrice Farmer" cmd /k "npm run dev:farmer" && start "AgriPrice MAO" cmd /k "npm run dev:mao" && start "AgriPrice Admin" cmd /k "npm run dev:admin"
